extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) Day and night formation — Earth rotates on its axis (an imaginary line through the center). One rotation takes 24 hours (1 day). When our side faces the sun, it is day. When our side faces away from the sun, it is night. The sun does not move — Earth moves. (2) Solar system and heavenly bodies — the sun is at the center. 8 planets go around the sun: Mercury (closest), Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter (biggest), Saturn (has rings), Uranus, Neptune (farthest). The moon goes around the Earth. Stars are huge balls of hot gas like our sun, very far away. (3) Concept of time — 1 day = 24 hours. 1 week = 7 days (Monday to Sunday). 1 month = about 30 days (28-31 days). 1 year = 12 months = 365 days. We use clocks to measure hours and minutes, calendars to measure days, weeks, months, and years. (4) Directions (left/right, above/below, near/far) — left and right are relative to which way we face. Above means higher than us, below means lower. Near means close, far means distant. (5) Four main directions — North (N), South (S), East (E), West (W). Sun rises in the EAST, sets in the WEST. If you face east (rising sun), your left hand points NORTH, right hand points SOUTH. North and South are opposites. East and West are opposites. A compass shows all four directions. Misconceptions: 'sun moves around Earth' (Earth moves around the sun, and Earth rotates to make day and night), 'sun is a planet' (sun is a STAR — a huge ball of hot gas that gives light and heat), 'all planets are the same size' (Jupiter is the biggest, Mercury is the smallest of the 8 planets), 'a week has 5 days' (a week has 7 days — Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday), 'if I face east, my right is north' (facing east: left=NORTH, right=SOUTH). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function SolarSystemGame), NOT export default. Export interface SolarSystemGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
